title: The Stone Circle
text: Nine standing stones lean together on the hill, and in their middle the grass is dry in the rain. The air there is warm and smells of old smoke. Old powers meet here at dusk. The sun is already low.

options.label: Wait in the circle for dusk.

outcomes.text: The powers come, and are curious, and are kind.
The powers come, and are not kind.

options.label: The wisest wards the circle so you can sleep in it.

outcomes.text: A full night's sleep, the first in days, and dreams of smoke.
Behind you, the stones begin to hum, and the hum fills you up like a drink.
Behind you, the stones begin to hum, and it is in the ground under your camp all night.

options.label: The Magus stays till dusk to speak with what comes.

outcomes.text: The old powers come, and speak, and the Magus understands one word in three. It is enough.
The old powers come, and the Magus understands every word, and wishes they did not.
